question: What is the unemployment rate (in percent) in urban area as per the report of Periodic Labor Force Survey (PLFS) 2020-21?
solution:
The correct answer is __**6.7**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• It shows that the u**nemployment rate fell to 4.2% in 2020-21**, compared with 4.8% in 2019-20.
 
• The rural areas recorded an unemployment rate of 3.3% and** urban areas recorded an unemployment rate of 6.7%__**.
 
• The percentage of persons in the labour force (that is, working or seeking work or available for work) in the population increased from 40.1% in the previous year to 41.6% during 2020-21.
 
• The **migration rate is 28.9%**. The migration rate among women was 48% and 47.8% in rural and urban areas, respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Unemployment Rate: The unemployment rate is defined as the percentage of unemployed persons in the labour force.
 
• Labour Force: Labour force refers to the part of the population which supplies or offers to supply labour for pursuing economic activities for the production of goods and services and therefore, includes both employed' and unemployed' persons.
 
• Periodic Labour Force Survey: The National Statistical Office (NSO) launched the Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) in April 2017.
 
• The objective of PLFS is primarily twofold:
 
 
• To estimate the key employment and unemployment indicators (viz. Worker Population Ratio, Labour Force Participation Rate, Unemployment Rate) in the short time interval of three months for the urban areas only in the CWS.
 
• To estimate employment and unemployment indicators in both usual Status and CWS in both rural and urban areas annually.
